title: Pure Volcanic
summary: Pure Volcanic burn and board-wipe strategy, harnessing Axel Brodie's Blaze Accelerator artillery to incinerate opposing monsters with Volcanic Scattershot and Emperor burns. The deck converts discarded Pyro ammo into massive effect damage and punishes every opponent summon.

summary.title: Starters
points: Volcanic Trooper searches any Volcanic card from your Deck upon Normal or Special Summon, and can discard 1 card to Special Summon a Bomb Token to the opponent's field that burns them for 500 damage when destroyed.
Volcanic Rimfire sends a Volcanic card from Deck to GY when sent to the GY, or banishes itself from GY to place a Blaze Accelerator card from hand or Deck face-up on field.
Volcanic Rocket searches a Blaze Accelerator card from Deck or GY upon Normal or Special Summon.
Volcanic Blaze Accelerator is a Continuous Spell that Special Summons a Volcanic monster from your hand each turn, and sends a Level 1 Pyro monster from Deck to GY to destroy an opponent's monster.
Fire Ejection sends a Pyro monster from Deck to GY to burn the opponent for its Level x 100, or Special Summons a Bomb Token to their field.

summary.title: Opening: Trooper + Volcanic Blaze Accelerator
steps: Normal Summon Volcanic Trooper; activate its on-summon effect to search Volcanic Blaze Accelerator from your Deck.
Activate Volcanic Blaze Accelerator's effect, sending Volcanic Rimfire from your Deck to the GY to destroy 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.
Rimfire triggers upon hitting the GY, banishing itself to place Blaze Accelerator Reload face-up from your Deck.
Activate Volcanic Trooper's second effect, discarding a card to summon a Bomb Token to the opponent's field.
Special Summon Volcanic Emperor from hand or GY by banishing 3 Pyro monsters (Trooper, Rimfire, and another Pyro) from your field or GY.
Emperor burns the opponent for 500 damage per banished Pyro (1500+ damage) and Sets Volcanic Emission directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Burn Artillery
points: Volcanic Emperor Special Summons itself from hand or GY by banishing 3 Pyro monsters or 1 Blaze Accelerator card from field/GY, burns the opponent for 500 damage per banished Pyro, Sets a Volcanic Trap from Deck, and burns the opponent for 500 damage every single time they Special Summon a monster.

Volcanic Doomfire must be Special Summoned by sending Tri-Blaze Accelerator to the GY, forces all opponent monsters to attack it during the Battle Phase, and destroys all opponent monsters and burns for 500 per destroyed monster after destroying a monster by battle.
Infernal Flame Banshee is a Rank 4 Pyro Xyz that detaches 1 material to add or send a Pyro monster from Deck, and banishes itself from GY to Special Summon a Volcanic monster from hand.
Infernal Flame Vixen is a Rank 4 Xyz that gains ATK for each banished monster and banishes up to 3 monsters from graveyards when destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Volcanic Scattershot inflicts 500 damage when sent to the GY, and when sent by a Blaze Accelerator card, sends 2 other Scattershots from hand/Deck to GY to destroy all monsters the opponent controls and burn for 1500 total damage.
Blaze Accelerator Reload counts as Tri-Blaze Accelerator, discards a Volcanic card during either Main Phase to draw 1 card, and banishes itself from GY to send a Volcanic card from Deck to GY.
Volcanic Emission Special Summons a Volcanic monster from your Deck ignoring summoning conditions, or targets a Pyro monster on field to inflict damage equal to its original ATK.

Volcanic Inferno is a Continuous Trap that banishes a Pyro monster from GY to burn for 500 damage when the opponent activates a monster effect on field, negating that effect if a Volcanic monster was banished.
